claims.text: The alloy is equimolar WTaTiVZr, corresponding to approximately 20 at.% of each element.
Thermal processing of equimolar WTaTiVZr produces coherent nanoscale precipitates.
The precipitates in the WTaTiVZr alloy are uniformly distributed.
The coherent nanoprecipitates are thermally stable under sustained loading at approximately 800–1000 °C.
Coherent nanoprecipitate interfaces facilitate dislocation transmission.
Coherent nanoprecipitates relieve local stress concentrations.
Relieving stress concentrations reduces premature crack initiation.
Nanoprecipitate-assisted dislocation transmission increases the WTaTiVZr alloy's ability to accommodate plastic deformation at 800–1000 °C.
The nanoprecipitate mechanism delays catastrophic failure of WTaTiVZr relative to pure tungsten.
At 800–1000 °C, WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater plastic strain to failure than commercially pure tungsten.
At 800–1000 °C, WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater toughness, including delayed crack initiation and propagation, than commercially pure tungsten.
The WTaTiVZr alloy can retain comparably high strength at elevated temperature.
Commercially pure tungsten has limited plastic strain and lower toughness under the same 800–1000 °C loading conditions.
Pure tungsten's poorer response is caused by its lack of the coherent-nanoprecipitate mechanisms present in the HEA.
The proposed nanoprecipitate mechanism is significant across roughly 800–1000 °C under plasma-facing-component stress regimes.
The mechanism may not manifest similarly at room temperature.
Loss of nanoprecipitate stability can suppress the proposed mechanism.
Processing parameters and environmental factors may affect the nanoprecipitates' quantitative contribution.
Matching thermal history, surface finish, and specimen geometry between compositionally different HEA and tungsten specimens isolates the nanoprecipitate effect.

contradictions.description: The comparison is said to isolate microstructural effects from compositional differences, but it directly compares compositionally distinct WTaTiVZr and pure tungsten and includes no composition-matched WTaTiVZr control lacking the precipitates. Thus composition and precipitate state remain confounded.
